title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
friendlyTitle: Diagram Design helps coding agents make clear diagrams
summary: A fast-rising toolkit for generating polished editorial diagrams with coding agents, covering 44 diagram types and producing self-contained HTML and SVG output.
friendlySummary: This open-source tool gives AI coding assistants many diagram styles and creates files you can keep and edit.
whyItMatters: Use it with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and other supported agents to turn architecture, process or data explanations into editable diagrams without relying on a hosted design service.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when you want an AI assistant to explain a system, process or set of data with a polished visual diagram.
